text.brief: In the summer of 1952 the British biochemist Joseph Needham toured sites in the northeast with an international commission and signed a report accusing the United States of germ warfare.
text.record: North Korea's foreign minister and then Zhou Enlai accused the United States in early 1952 of dropping infected insects and other agents ([Wilson Center, CWIHP Working Paper 78: Leitenberg, China's False Allegations of the Use of Biological Weapons by the United States during the Korean War](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/sites/default/files/media/documents/publication/cwihp_wp_78_china_false_bw_allegations_korean_war_march_16.pdf)). Captured American airmen signed confessions under duress, and the International Scientific Commission endorsed the charge that September ([Wilson Center, CWIHP Working Paper 78 (Leitenberg)](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/sites/default/files/media/documents/publication/cwihp_wp_78_china_false_bw_allegations_korean_war_march_16.pdf)). Soviet documents published in 1998 showed that officials had fabricated the evidence ([Wilson Center, Cold War International History Project Bulletin 11 (1998): new evidence on the allegations](https://www.wilsoncenter.org/sites/default/files/media/documents/publication/CWIHPBulletin11_p4.pdf); [Wilson Center blog: Soviet, Chinese and North Korean false allegations of biological weapons use](https://wilsoncenter.org/blog-post/soviet-chinese-and-north-korean-false-allegations-biological-weapons-use-during-korean)).
text.reading: The campaign borrowed a scientist's standing to certify a fiction, which is Stratagem 14. A lie certified by a respected foreign name survives long after the archives expose it, and the Party has never withdrawn the charge.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. The defender had no fast, independent investigation the accusers would admit.
text.fix: Keep standing agreements for independent inspection of alleged biological attacks and invite inspectors at once when accused.
